# SynelWeb

> SynelWeb is the one-person web development business of Szilveszter Németh in Sopron, Hungary. It builds custom, fast websites, landing pages and online shops for small businesses in Hungary and Austria (Burgenland, Vienna), without templates or page builders, and manages Google Search ads. Every project includes ongoing hosting and maintenance.

Languages: Hungarian (main), English, German. Contact: info@synelweb.hu, +36 30 364 5516. Meetings in person around Sopron, Burgenland and Vienna, or online anywhere.
